summary.text: Kevin Cramer was elected to the U.S. Senate from North Dakota on November 6, 2018, after serving three terms as the state's at-large U.S. Representative.

paragraphs.text: He was appointed to the North Dakota Public Service Commission in 2003 and elected to it in 2004.
He has a B.A. from Concordia College in Moorhead, Minnesota, and a master's degree in management from the University of Mary in Bismarck.
He is a native of Kindred, North Dakota.
